event.title: Explosion at Moscow restaurant results in three fatalities and multiple injuries
event.canonical_title: Explosion at Moscow restaurant results in three fatalities and multiple injuries
event.summary: An explosion occurred at a restaurant in central Moscow, killing three people and injuring at least 15 others. Security officials reported that a woman attempted to enter the restaurant with explosives but was stopped by a security guard before the device detonated. Investigators and emergency services are currently at the scene.

timeline.title: Explosion at Moscow Restaurant Kills Three and Injures Over Twenty
timeline.summary: A bombing near an upscale restaurant in central Moscow resulted in the deaths of three people and injuries to at least 21 others. Authorities reported that a woman attempted to enter the restaurant with a homemade bomb but was stopped by a security guard before the device detonated. The incident has been labeled a 'terrorist act' by the city's mayor.
